The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored gray tunic, asymmetric/offset fastening, divided lower panels and trousers, narrow reinforced cuffs, belts, single clay tea token, pale contrasting laces, and polished plum boots preserve the summon wardrobe and palette without added accessories or markings.
